project.name: Air Quality Monitoring – DataOps & MLOps
project.description: Real-time anomaly detection platform for air quality monitoring using IoT simulation, Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, PostgreSQL, Apache Airflow, MLflow, FastAPI, and Streamlit.

member_1.role: Project Manager / Scrum Master / Kafka / Airflow / DevOps

member_3.role: ML Engineer / Scikit-learn / MLflow / FastAPI / Dashboard

sprints.name: Sprint 1 – Setup & Data Ingestion
sprints.goal: Project initialization, Docker environment, Python IoT sensor simulator, and Kafka streaming topics.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 – Data Processing & Orchestration
sprints.goal: Spark Structured Streaming, cleaning, business anomaly rules, PostgreSQL storage, and Airflow orchestration.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 – Machine Learning & MLflow
sprints.goal: EDA, feature engineering, anomaly detection model comparison (Random Forest, Isolation Forest), MLflow tracking & registry.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 – API & Dashboard
sprints.goal: FastAPI prediction service, model loading, Streamlit interactive monitoring dashboard, and data catalog view.

sprints.name: Sprint 5 – Testing & Final Delivery
sprints.goal: End-to-end integration testing, bug fixes, Docker Compose validation, LaTeX technical report, slides, and demo script.

epics.description: Build IoT sensor simulator and Apache Kafka streaming infrastructure with multi-topic routing.

stories.summary: Develop realistic IoT Air Quality Sensor Generator
stories.description: Simulate multi-sensor air quality stations emitting PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, temperature, humidity in JSON format with realistic circadian patterns and occasional anomalous spikes.
acceptance_criteria: Output JSON strictly matches academic specification schema with sensor_id, timestamp, location, measurements, status.
Normal values oscillate within realistic European/WHO outdoor ranges.
Configurable anomaly injection rate (spikes, high pollution, sensor malfunction).
Unit tests validate schema and range constraints.

tasks.summary: Implement baseline sensor math and circadian variations

stories.summary: Configure Apache Kafka Cluster and Multi-Topic Routing
stories.description: Provision Kafka broker and Zookeeper with topics raw_data, processed_data, anomalies, plus Python producer/consumer wrappers.
acceptance_criteria: Topics raw_data, processed_data, and anomalies are auto-created.
Producer implements JSON serialization, error retries, and rate limiting.
Consumer handles offset management and graceful shutdown.
Integration test confirms end-to-end message delivery.

epics.description: Implement streaming ETL with Apache Spark, data validation, domain anomaly detection, and PostgreSQL storage.

stories.summary: Data Cleaning, Validation, and Metric Aggregation
stories.description: Implement robust data cleaning pipelines handling missing values, duplicate sensors, physical boundary checks, and rolling statistics.
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-range sensor readings flagged or sanitized.
Deduplication across sensor_id and timestamp window.
Rolling window statistics calculated (mean, max, std).
Cleaned output formatted for database persistence.

stories.description: Implement rule-based anomaly detection based on European Union / WHO Air Quality directives.
acceptance_criteria: Detects PM2.5 > 50 µg/m³, PM10 > 100 µg/m³, NO2 > 200 µg/m³, O3 > 180 µg/m³.
Detects rapid rate-of-change spikes.
Emits anomaly alert records with severity classification (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

stories.description: Design relational schema for sensors, measurements, anomalies, model predictions, and data lineage catalog.
acceptance_criteria: DDL creates tables with primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes.
Upsert logic prevents duplicate measurement insertions.
Connection layer supports connection pooling and resilient SQLite fallback.
Unit tests verify CRUD operations and schema migrations.

epics.description: Orchestrate automated pipelines using Apache Airflow DAGs with sensors, conditional branching, backfilling, and alerting.

stories.description: Implement daily workflow: Extract Sensors Data -> Validate Quality -> Train Model -> Evaluate Model -> Model Improvement? -> Deploy if Better / End.
acceptance_criteria: Airflow Sensor checks data availability before pipeline run.
Tasks execute sequentially with error handling and retry policies.
BranchPythonOperator decides whether newly trained model outperforms production.
Custom MLflow operator or PythonOperator logs run metadata.

stories.description: Create backfill DAG for historical reprocessing and configure Slack/Email failure callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Backfill DAG accepts execution_date parameters.
Failure callbacks log diagnostic messages and notify team webhook.
Idempotency verified on backfill executions.

epics.description: Train, evaluate, track, and register machine learning models for air quality anomaly classification.

stories.description: Build reproducible preprocessing pipeline with temporal features, rolling statistics, pollutant ratios, and leak-free split.
acceptance_criteria: Time-based chronological train/test split (no lookahead data leakage).
Feature scaler fitted strictly on training partition.
Preprocessed feature matrices saved and versioned.

stories.description: Train and evaluate at least two classification algorithms: Random Forest vs Gradient Boosting / Isolation Forest.
acceptance_criteria: Compare algorithms on Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC.
Generate confusion matrix and classification report.
Ensure reproducible random states.

stories.description: Log parameters, metrics, confusion matrix figures, model artifacts to MLflow, and register best model to Production.
acceptance_criteria: Every training run logged under MLflow experiment.
Artifacts include model.joblib and evaluation plots.
Model Registry registers model and updates stage: Staging -> Production.
Airflow and API seamlessly load model by registered stage.

tasks.summary: Integrate MLflow tracking and registry into ml/train.py

epics.description: Expose real-time predictions via FastAPI and visualize stream metrics on an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

stories.description: Implement REST API exposing endpoints: GET /health, POST /predict, GET /anomalies, GET /measurements, GET /catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic schemas validate request payloads strictly.
Inference latency < 50ms per item.
Swagger / OpenAPI documentation generated automatically at /docs.
Endpoint returns anomaly status, probability score, and triggered rules.

stories.description: Build Streamlit dashboard displaying live sensor gauges, pollutant time series, anomaly tables, map markers, and DataOps metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Shows latest PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, temperature, humidity.
Interactive charts with threshold markers (WHO limits).
Real-time anomaly counter and severity breakdown.
Data catalog and pipeline freshness indicators for professor demo.

epics.description: Containerize all microservices with Docker Compose, validate networking, and implement full pytest test suite.

stories.description: Configure multi-container orchestration: Kafka, Zookeeper, PostgreSQL, Airflow, MLflow, FastAPI, and Streamlit.
acceptance_criteria: Single docker-compose up command starts all services with health checks.
Persistent volumes configured for PostgreSQL, Kafka, and MLflow data.
Service dependencies (depends_on) ensure proper boot sequence.

stories.summary: Comprehensive Unit, Integration, and End-to-End Tests
stories.description: Develop pytest test suite covering sensor generator, Kafka producer/consumer, cleaning, database, ML, API, and pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: All unit and integration tests pass with 0 failures.
Edge cases covered (corrupt values, missing fields, schema mismatches).
End-to-end simulation validates data flow from generator to database.

epics.description: Produce complete academic deliverables: GitHub README, LaTeX technical report, presentation slides, and live demo script.

stories.summary: Comprehensive GitHub README and Architecture Documentation
stories.description: Document complete system architecture, sequence diagrams, quickstart instructions, API references, and team contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Clear setup instructions for Docker and local running.
Detailed API usage examples with curl and JSON payloads.
Team attribution and Jira/Sprint alignment documented.

stories.summary: Academic Technical Report in LaTeX (Overleaf compatible)
stories.description: Write complete academic report with title page, abstract, table of contents, justified tech choices, architecture, experimental results, and conclusion.
acceptance_criteria: Full LaTeX structure (.tex files) with bibliography and figures.
Covers problem statement, DataOps & MLOps rationale, and metrics.
Compiles cleanly into PDF without syntax errors.

Live demonstration scenario includes sensor anomaly injection and real-time alert trigger.
